## Finding and confidence

What is established, and what is still an inference?

## Setup

Firmware, macOS, transport, app/probe commit, and capture date. Do not include serial numbers or Bluetooth addresses.

## Exact bytes

Include requests and replies, direction, packet boundaries, timing, and expected sequence/slot.

## Reproduction and test

Describe what action produced the capture and whether the operation reads or changes device state. Link an offline replay test when available.
